chunks: Ahmad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Al-Mithamī, from Abū Baseer, from Abū 'Abdillāh (peace be upon him)
that he disliked that the bread be placed under the bowl.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on placing bread under the bowl in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) expresses dislike for placing the loaf of bread directly beneath the serving bowl, a practice rooted in the Shia emphasis on honoring the sustenance of Allah. This etiquette reflects the broader theological principle that bread, as a primary staple, deserves respect and should not be treated as a mere placemat or trivet, thereby elevating the mundane act of eating into an act of gratitude.

en.hubeali: Ahmad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Al Maysami, from Abu Baseer,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having disliked that the bread be placed under the bowl’.
en.sarwar: 12. Ahmad has narrated from ibn Faddal from af-Mithamiy from abu Basir who has said the foiiowing: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
disliked placing of the loaf of bread under the dish.’”
